notes.title: Update pack #1
notes.content:
We continue to fulfill your wishes and some of the problems you identified have been fixed in today's fresh game update.

It includes:
[olist]
[*] Fixed the problem of [b]premature ending of waves[/b] in Arcade mode, as well as premature ending of the stream of enemies in Adrenaline mode.

[*] Fixed a [b]layout conflict for the HTC Vive[/b] headset where pressing the trackpad up would bring up the pause menu.
 
[*] On the "Cemetery" map, [b]stunned enemies[/b] falling into a ravine have been fixed, which, in turn, could cause a delay or stop the game process.
[/olist]

Additionally we will be glad to see your gameplays, reviews and streams from Germany, China and other countries with strict regional requirements, where the game became available from today.

We keep our finger on the pulse and look forward to your feedback!

notes.title: Update: smooth turning
notes.content:
We are very grateful for your feedback on the recent release of the game! 
And we really try to have time to read everyone's opinion.

We also listen to your valuable feedback, which can make the gameplay in "Federation77" more comfortable for VR players and shooter fans. And...one of your wishes was very quickly fulfilled!

Smooth turn is now available as an option. For that, set the settings as shown in the screenshot.

notes.title: "Federation77" released on Steam
notes.content:
"Federation77" is a dynamic VR first-person shooter in attraction format, set in a setting where the era of Perestroika, criminal gangs and other attributes of the dashing 90s in the post-Soviet space are mixed with the aesthetic of cyberpunk 2077 year.

The main hero, who lives in a sleeping area of the city of M, goes out to meet his "favorite" neighbors. The morality of the people here has fallen and now a simple trip to get some bread is a hell of an adventure. 
This whole city is a goddamn ghetto... 
And you are a cyber-psychic in this city whose program has malfunctioned because of the "Taras-Kulish" critical error, which encourages you to kill. It's time to clean the streets of filth.

[b]What awaits you in the game:[/b]
[list]
[*] Ultra-violence on enemies is the only way to the top of the rankings.
[*] Different factions of enemies, specific to the region, with their own characteristics: drunks, cyberpunks, riot police (OMON), sheep as suicide bombers (shahids), Matryoshka doll and others.
[*] Adrenaline-fueled firefights with the need for constant motion will complement your fitness training program.
[*] Several game modes provide a unique experience.
[*] A variety of arsenal with different types of weapon behavior.
[/list]

[b]About MiroWin Studios.[/b]
Founded in 2017, MiroWin is a developer and publisher of video games for PC, VR and consoles. The studio's portfolio includes "Guns'n'Stories: Bulletproof VR" western-shooter, "Boiling Steel" story-based sci-fi VR shooter, "TinShift" PC multiplayer arena-shooter. 
MiroWin is an official partner of Oculus, HTC, Playstation, Pico, Nolo and Huawei.
On November 3, 2022 release of the "Desperate: Vladivostok," a joint VR project with the US publisher PM Studios is planned on Steam and Meta Quest. 
For more information, visit [url=mirowin.com]mirowin.com[/url] and subscribe to @mirowinvr on [url=https://www.facebook.com/MiroWinVR]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/MirowinVR]Twitter[/url] or [url=https://www.youtube.com/c/MiroWinVR]Youtube[/url].

notes.title: "RU77" is "Federation77" now
notes.content:
Hello, friends!

Happy to inform about the last news regarding "[strike]RU77[/strike]" project.

[h2]Name change[/h2]
We changed the name of this Post-Soviet cyberpunk PC VR arena-shooter to "[b]Federation77[/b]", keeping the same place of events and scenery - a certain country in the post-Soviet space in the year 2077.

[previewyoutube=M8VnCPnhYZY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Release date[/h2]
We resumed the work with this project and Oculus Rift owners will have the possibility to try in already soon. 
[b]October 6, 2022[/b] - release date on Steam. 

[h2]About the idea[/h2]
The player will have to meet in the arena with Lumpenproletariat - the criminal elements and other asocials, from existing at all times boozers to mutated former soldiers and crazy members of special forces, ardent supporters of nuclear war and special weapons, more powerful than combat pigeons, and many others.
Those who have sunk to the underworld and who are alien to do the socially useful work seek to make everything around them destructive in their likeness. 

More information on our pages will come closer to the release date.

Welcome to our [url=https://www.facebook.com/MiroWinVR]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/MirowinVR]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.youtube.com/c/MiroWinVR]Youtube[/url] for more detailed information.
